# Divizion Launcher

Divizion is an independent Minecraft Java launcher for Windows, macOS and Linux.
It manages instances, Java runtimes, modloaders, mods, modpacks and servers.
It integrates Modrinth and supports Microsoft and offline accounts.
Time Machine is experimental. Legacy is not yet available.

## Official project
- Website: https://divizion.fr
- Documentation: https://divizion.fr/wiki/

- JSON documentation source: https://github.com/divizion-project/divizion-docu/tree/main/docs
- Terms: https://divizion.fr/legal/
- Privacy: https://divizion.fr/privacy/

Divizion is not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft.
